Option 2: OBJECT curve as reference

Setup

library(tidyverse)
## ── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ──

library(readxl)
library(mgcv)
## Loading required package: nlme
## 
## Attaching package: 'nlme'

## This is mgcv 1.9-3. For overview type 'help("mgcv-package")'.
data_file <- "/Users/zixinli05/Desktop/spc_c1_data_new9.xlsx"
participants_sheet <- "Participants"
min_checks <- 7
min_accuracy_pct <- 75
blocks_to_use <- 1

k_delay  <- 10
k_person <- 5

cols_main   <- c(intact = "#F8766D", scrambled = "#00BFC4")
labels_main <- c(intact = "Agent", scrambled = "Object")
cols_groups   <- c(Agent = "#F8766D", Object_fixed = "#E6B800", Object_random = "#7B3FA0")
labels_groups <- c(Agent = "Agent", Object_fixed = "Object-fixed", Object_random = "Object-random")

Data

raw <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = "Trials")

attn <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = participants_sheet) %>%
  mutate(
    attentionCheckCorrect = as.numeric(attentionCheckCorrect),
    attentionCheckTotal = as.numeric(attentionCheckTotal),
    accuracy_pct = 100 * attentionCheckCorrect / attentionCheckTotal,
    passed = !is.na(attentionCheckTotal) &
             attentionCheckTotal >= min_checks &
             accuracy_pct >= min_accuracy_pct
  )

model_dat <- raw %>%
  filter(rowKey %in% attn$rowKey[attn$passed],
         block %in% blocks_to_use) %>%
  mutate(
    participant = factor(prolificPID),
    delay_ms = as.numeric(delay_ms),
    causal_rating = as.numeric(causal_rating),
    group = case_when(
      condition == "intact" ~ "Agent",
      scrambled_version == "C" ~ "Object_fixed",
      scrambled_version == "D" ~ "Object_random",
      TRUE ~ "Object_other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(participant, condition, group, delay_ms, causal_rating) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  droplevels()

model_dat %>% distinct(participant, condition) %>% count(condition)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   condition     n
##   <chr>     <int>
## 1 intact       10
## 2 scrambled     8
model_dat %>% distinct(participant, group) %>% count(group)
## # A tibble: 4 × 2
##   group             n
##   <chr>         <int>
## 1 Agent            10
## 2 Object_fixed      2
## 3 Object_other      4
## 4 Object_random     2

Main analysis

main_dat <- model_dat %>%
  mutate(condition_o = factor(condition, levels = c("scrambled", "intact"), ordered = TRUE))
contrasts(main_dat$condition_o) <- "contr.treatment"

gamm_main <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    condition_o +
    s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition_o, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = main_dat,
  method = "REML"
)
## Warning in gam.side(sm, X, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5): model has repeated
## 1-d smooths of same variable.
summary(gamm_main)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## causal_rating ~ condition_o + s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, 
##     by = condition_o, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, participant, 
##     bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                   Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)         51.985      6.095    8.53 2.09e-15 ***
## condition_ointact   19.791      8.177    2.42   0.0163 *  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                                  edf Ref.df     F p-value    
## s(delay_ms)                    7.520  8.331 7.637  <2e-16 ***
## s(delay_ms):condition_ointact  3.985  4.769 2.587    0.03 *  
## s(delay_ms,participant)       65.189 88.000 8.687  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.828   Deviance explained = 87.2%
## -REML =   1316  Scale est. = 174.35    n = 306
summary(gamm_main)$s.table["s(delay_ms):condition_ointact", ]
##       edf    Ref.df         F   p-value 
## 3.9849721 4.7688253 2.5874385 0.0300313
gam.check(gamm_main)

## 
## Method: REML   Optimizer: outer newton
## full convergence after 6 iterations.
## Gradient range [-0.0003265835,0.0002475249]
## (score 1315.975 & scale 174.3522).
## Hessian positive definite, eigenvalue range [0.5768638,155.9674].
## Model rank =  110 / 110 
## 
## Basis dimension (k) checking results. Low p-value (k-index<1) may
## indicate that k is too low, especially if edf is close to k'.
## 
##                                  k'   edf k-index p-value
## s(delay_ms)                    9.00  7.52    1.03    0.72
## s(delay_ms):condition_ointact  9.00  3.98    1.03    0.69
## s(delay_ms,participant)       90.00 65.19    1.03    0.61
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(-1000, 1000, length.out = 300),
  condition_o = levels(main_dat$condition_o),
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)
newdat$condition_o <- factor(newdat$condition_o, levels = levels(main_dat$condition_o), ordered = is.ordered(main_dat$condition_o))
if (is.ordered(newdat$condition_o)) contrasts(newdat$condition_o) <- "contr.treatment"

pred <- predict(gamm_main, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(delay_ms,participant)")
newdat$fit <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)

obs <- main_dat %>%
  group_by(condition_o, delay_ms) %>%
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(causal_rating), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(newdat, aes(x = delay_ms, y = fit, color = condition_o, fill = condition_o)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = delay_ms, y = mean_rating, color = condition_o),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_main, labels = labels_main) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_main, labels = labels_main) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Temporal delay (ms)", y = "Causal judgment", color = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Option 2: OBJECT as reference")

Exploratory analysis: OBJECT-fixed vs. OBJECT-random

expl_dat <- model_dat %>%
  filter(group %in% c("Agent", "Object_fixed", "Object_random")) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    condition_o = factor(group, levels = c("Agent", "Object_fixed", "Object_random"), ordered = TRUE),
    condition_o_fixed = factor(group, levels = c("Object_fixed", "Agent", "Object_random"), ordered = TRUE)
  )
contrasts(expl_dat$condition_o) <- "contr.treatment"
contrasts(expl_dat$condition_o_fixed) <- "contr.treatment"

expl_dat %>% distinct(participant, group) %>% count(group)
## # A tibble: 3 × 2
##   group             n
##   <chr>         <int>
## 1 Agent            10
## 2 Object_fixed      2
## 3 Object_random     2
gamm_groups_agent <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    condition_o +
    s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition_o, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = expl_dat,
  method = "REML"
)
## Warning in gam.side(sm, X, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5): model has repeated
## 1-d smooths of same variable.
summary(gamm_groups_agent)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## causal_rating ~ condition_o + s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, 
##     by = condition_o, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, participant, 
##     bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                          Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                71.776      6.365  11.277   <2e-16 ***
## condition_oObject_fixed   -21.276     15.591  -1.365    0.174    
## condition_oObject_random  -12.306     15.591  -0.789    0.431    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                                         edf Ref.df     F p-value    
## s(delay_ms)                           6.684  7.730 2.531  0.0132 *  
## s(delay_ms):condition_oObject_fixed   2.252  2.606 1.378  0.2754    
## s(delay_ms):condition_oObject_random  5.608  6.682 2.163  0.0333 *  
## s(delay_ms,participant)              45.557 67.000 9.516  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.819   Deviance explained = 86.6%
## -REML = 1014.2  Scale est. = 172.29    n = 238
gamm_groups_fixed <- gam(
  causal_rating ~
    condition_o_fixed +
    s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition_o_fixed, k = k_delay) +
    s(delay_ms, participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1),
  data = expl_dat,
  method = "REML"
)
## Warning in gam.side(sm, X, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5): model has repeated
## 1-d smooths of same variable.
summary(gamm_groups_fixed)
## 
## Family: gaussian 
## Link function: identity 
## 
## Formula:
## causal_rating ~ condition_o_fixed + s(delay_ms, k = k_delay) + 
##     s(delay_ms, by = condition_o_fixed, k = k_delay) + s(delay_ms, 
##     participant, bs = "fs", k = k_person, m = 1)
## 
## Parametric coefficients:
##                                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                      50.500     14.233   3.548 0.000498 ***
## condition_o_fixedAgent           21.276     15.591   1.365 0.174117    
## condition_o_fixedObject_random    8.971     20.128   0.446 0.656385    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:
##                                               edf Ref.df     F p-value    
## s(delay_ms)                                 6.857  7.851 2.786  0.0067 ** 
## s(delay_ms):condition_o_fixedAgent          1.597  1.758 1.625  0.2989    
## s(delay_ms):condition_o_fixedObject_random  5.306  6.352 1.537  0.1344    
## s(delay_ms,participant)                    46.221 67.000 9.591  <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## R-sq.(adj) =  0.819   Deviance explained = 86.6%
## -REML = 1014.4  Scale est. = 172.54    n = 238
p_raw <- c(
  "Agent vs. Object_fixed" =
    summary(gamm_groups_agent)$s.table["s(delay_ms):condition_oObject_fixed", "p-value"],
  "Agent vs. Object_random" =
    summary(gamm_groups_agent)$s.table["s(delay_ms):condition_oObject_random", "p-value"],
  "Object_fixed vs. Object_random" =
    summary(gamm_groups_fixed)$s.table["s(delay_ms):condition_o_fixedObject_random", "p-value"]
)

tibble(test = names(p_raw), p = p_raw, p_holm = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "holm"))
## # A tibble: 3 × 3
##   test                                p p_holm
##   <chr>                           <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 Agent vs. Object_fixed         0.275   0.275
## 2 Agent vs. Object_random        0.0333  0.100
## 3 Object_fixed vs. Object_random 0.134   0.269
newdat <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(-1000, 1000, length.out = 300),
  condition_o = levels(expl_dat$condition_o),
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)
newdat$condition_o <- factor(newdat$condition_o, levels = levels(expl_dat$condition_o), ordered = is.ordered(expl_dat$condition_o))
if (is.ordered(newdat$condition_o)) contrasts(newdat$condition_o) <- "contr.treatment"

pred <- predict(gamm_groups_agent, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE, exclude = "s(delay_ms,participant)")
newdat$fit <- as.numeric(pred$fit)
newdat$lower <- newdat$fit - 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)
newdat$upper <- newdat$fit + 1.96 * as.numeric(pred$se.fit)

obs <- expl_dat %>%
  group_by(condition_o, delay_ms) %>%
  summarise(mean_rating = mean(causal_rating), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(newdat, aes(x = delay_ms, y = fit, color = condition_o, fill = condition_o)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = obs, aes(x = delay_ms, y = mean_rating, color = condition_o),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_groups, labels = labels_groups) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_groups, labels = labels_groups) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Temporal delay (ms)", y = "Causal judgment", color = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Exploratory: three groups")
